summaryTemplate: 10.5+ years in enterprise SaaS, building across React, TypeScript, and Node.js. Currently leading an engineering team on a platform managing millions of customer endpoints, owning frontend architecture across a 12-package monorepo, design systems, build and runtime performance, alongside AI-native engineering with LLM orchestration and MCP servers. {seeking}
snapshot: AI test-authoring platform that cut full product regression from 6 hours of manual testing to a 40-minute automated run.
Headless Base UI design system with an AI agent that generates production components from a Figma link, taking page development from 2 days of AI-assisted work to a few hours.
96% faster dev builds, 2 minutes to 5 seconds across 12 monorepo packages.
70% faster initial page load, 5 seconds down to 1.5 seconds.
Hired 9 engineers and mentored 10+ more across SuperOps and Freshworks, at 90% retention.

experience.title: Senior Lead Software Engineer
bullets: Hands-on delivery of enterprise features in React and TypeScript, including role-based access control (RBAC) and near-real-time operational dashboards tuned with custom cached Apollo hooks to balance data freshness against network load, in partnership with product and UI/UX teams.

Lead and manage a frontend team of 6 engineers on a platform managing millions of customer endpoints, shipping weekly, owning sprint planning, architecture reviews, hiring and interviews, coaching and performance feedback, career development, and roadmap prioritisation with product managers.

Reduced dev build time by 96%, from 2 minutes to 5 seconds, through a solo Webpack 5 to Rspack migration delivered in 3 weeks across 12 monorepo packages, reclaiming roughly 50 engineer-hours a month across a 15-engineer frontend org and accelerating time-to-market for every downstream feature.

Reduced manual regression effort and release risk by architecting an AI test-authoring platform in React and Node.js that orchestrates LLM agents to generate, execute, and self-heal end-to-end test suites, streaming real-time results over HTTP Web Streams, cutting full product regression from 6 hours of manual testing to a 40-minute automated run in Jenkins CI/CD across a 300+ test-case Playwright suite.

Improved developer productivity by integrating custom Claude Code skills and MCP servers into the production development workflow, with multi-tier write-scope guardrails that let engineers run autonomous agents without exposing core platform interfaces to risk.
Built a Python MCP server exposing the frontend codebase as a queryable graph, now used by AI tooling across multiple engineering teams.

Built a headless Base UI design system of 30+ reusable components now used across 40 to 50+ pages and sections, with customised design tokens and a Claude Code skill that generates production components from a Figma node link via MCP, reducing page development from 2 days of AI-assisted engineering to a few hours.

Cut initial page load from 5 seconds to 1.5 seconds through route-level code splitting, React lazy loading (Suspense), and per-package bundle chunking, removing slowness-related support tickets, and eliminated 30,000+ lines of dead code and unused dependencies to reduce technical debt and the build and security surface.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer (Customer-Facing Engineering)
bullets: Acted as the technical point of contact for 100+ mid-market and enterprise accounts over a four-year tenure, partnering with Support, Customer Success, and Sales to turn complex account requirements into solutions that unblocked onboarding and renewals, recognised with the Customer Champion Award.
Reduced support handling effort by building a Customer 360 dashboard consolidating support, sales, and account data into a single operational view.

Built tier-1 SaaS integrations over REST API services, the Jira integration adopted by 4,000+ Freshworks customers, alongside Salesforce, Zendesk, and ServiceNow for 100+ mid-market and enterprise customers, expanding platform fit in enterprise deals.

Developed features end-to-end across Freshworks products, building the React UI with the Node.js REST API services and MySQL data layer behind it, and shipped reusable add-ons in place of one-off custom development.
Mentored 6 to 7 junior and onboarding engineers on React, REST API development, and UI architecture through structured code and design reviews, accelerating team onboarding.

bullets: Built an admin dashboard that dynamically priced Stripe plans across feature selection, storage tiers, and bandwidth limits, increasing self-serve revenue.
Built video player customisation from scratch with configurable controls, annotations, and call-to-action overlays, increasing viewer conversion.
Built responsive, high-converting company and product landing pages.
Integrated Freshservice with DocuSign over REST API services, unlocking a $500K ARR enterprise deal, and joined Freshworks with the team on acquisition.
